content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

The infrastructure behind selling music online without Stripe focuses on sovereignty and ownership. In many countries, digital creators face limitations when trying to access conventional payment platforms. This sovereign architecture eliminates those barriers, allowing creators to sell directly to their audience. By utilizing cryptocurrency payment solutions like NOWPayments, creators can accept payments without incurring the high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on each sale. This model empowers creators to retain control over their revenue and build sustainable businesses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The sovereign digital commerce stack operates on a combination of free and paid tools to create an efficient selling environment. At its core, it leverages platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, with backend logic managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage is handled via Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery utilizes Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of 0.5%. This stack not only simplifies the setup process but also ensures that creators maintain full ownership of their data and infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment systems are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Whether you are a musician selling beats, an author distributing ebooks, or a designer offering templates and fonts, this stack empowers you to bypass traditional financial barriers. By adopting this model, creators can reach a global audience while avoiding platform dependency and high transaction fees, enabling them to focus on their craft without worrying about payment rejections or currency volatility.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings with NOWPayments instead of losing 10% to Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of this infrastructure relies on its individual components functioning harmoniously. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the foundation for hosting your digital products, while backend processes are managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automating essential tasks like order processing. Supabase or Google Sheets provides reliable order storage, ensuring that you can track sales easily. File delivery is handled seamlessly through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and NOWPayments facilitates real-time cryptocurrency transactions. Together, these components create a robust framework that supports a sovereign online store.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your sovereign digital commerce stack, first, choose your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing. Then, select your order storage system, either Supabase or Google Sheets, to keep track of sales. For file delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to manage your digital products. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to enable seamless cryptocurrency transactions. By following these steps, you can launch your online store and accept payments without relying on conventional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack. This stack combines free hosting, automated backend processing, and cryptocurrency payment solutions like NOWPayments. This architecture allows creators to retain ownership of their data and reduce transaction costs significantly, enabling direct sales to their audience.
Deploy your online store today without the restrictions of traditional payment platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those searching for ways to sell ebooks or templates without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack effectively. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions

Use a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes hosting, backend automation, and cryptocurrency payments. Platforms like NOWPayments facilitate accepting payments without traditional processors, ensuring you can monetize your ebooks directly.

Implement your own digital commerce stack using tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This architecture minimizes fees and allows you to keep more of your earnings compared to platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can create a sovereign online store using a combination of free hosting services and cryptocurrency payment solutions. This way, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers without any fees imposed by traditional platforms.
What are the advantages of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments offers low transaction fees of only 0.5%, supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, and does not require KYC for buyers. This makes it an ideal solution for digital creators who want to accept payments seamlessly.
How can I ensure full data ownership when selling online?

By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you retain complete ownership of your data. Unlike conventional platforms, your data remains under your control, allowing you to manage your sales and customer information without restrictions.
